job.structural_change: result deskew 5 + PT4 + 1 a tile hop (OT_SMH_PINREG): the gated SM tile cluster r14 lands rin / bin in its own pin registers, so a column's results arrive one cycle later per hop; +276 deskew flops per side.  Same module text otherwise (the native snapshot's front_s), same outline and pin plan as smn_front_s_ref r1 (CLOSED TT +207.5 / FF +4.6); live rtl/ sources
job.purpose: ot_hbm_accel_smh_front_s for the SM whose tiles are the r14 gated clusters (smh_tile_eg_ref / smh_tile_wg_ref with OT_SMH_PINREG): identical to the native front_s but for the result deskew (7 a hop instead of 6).  A separate kit, so the closed smn_front_s_ref view (6 a hop) stays valid for a composition with pre-r14 tiles; the die lead takes the front that matches the tile it places.  Benches: the full production-shape SM (NC 8, 8 active columns, RMAX 4096, request credit, hierarchical gated tiles with pin registers) 13-op stress sequence bit-exact with the clock-gating lockstep at 0 mismatches; the deskew mutant (front built WITHOUT the extra hop cycle against PINREG tiles) must mismatch.

benches.name: lockstep_pinreg
benches.cmd: export PATH=/home/ubuntu/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH; W=$(mktemp -d /tmp/smfs.XXXXXX); python3 tools/dshbm_sm_pq_seq.py run --seq stress --nc 8 --active 8 --rmax 4096 --req-credit --smh --cg --define OT_SMH_CG_ENREG --define OT_SMH_XLK --define OT_FP_DATA_NORST --define OT_SMH_DRST0 --define OT_SMH_RSTRELAY --define OT_SMH_RSTPIN --define OT_SMH_HIER --define OT_SMH_PTW_OHDLY --define OT_SMH_PINREG --define OT_SMH_PRODUCTION_SHAPE --cg-gap 300 --build-jobs 8 --workdir $W --out {RUN}/b_lockstep_pinreg.json > {RUN}/b_lockstep_pinreg.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 {RUN}/b_lockstep_pinreg.log; grep -h CG_LOCKSTEP $W/*/runtime.log; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q 'CG_LOCKSTEP mismatches 0 ' $W/*/runtime.log && echo SMFS_LOCKSTEP_PASS

benches.name: mut_deskew
benches.cmd: export PATH=/home/ubuntu/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH; W=$(mktemp -d /tmp/smfs.XXXXXX); python3 tools/dshbm_sm_pq_seq.py run --seq stress --nc 8 --active 8 --rmax 4096 --req-credit --smh --cg --define OT_SMH_CG_ENREG --define OT_SMH_XLK --define OT_FP_DATA_NORST --define OT_SMH_DRST0 --define OT_SMH_RSTRELAY --define OT_SMH_RSTPIN --define OT_SMH_HIER --define OT_SMH_PTW_OHDLY --define OT_SMH_PINREG --define OT_SMH_PRODUCTION_SHAPE --define OT_SMH_MUT_PINR_DESKEW --cg-gap 300 --build-jobs 8 --workdir $W --out {RUN}/b_mut_deskew.json > {RUN}/b_mut_deskew.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 {RUN}/b_mut_deskew.log; grep -h CG_LOCKSTEP $W/*/runtime.log; python3 -c 'import json,sys; x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert x["timeout"] is None and x["mismatching_ops"] > 0; print("SMFS_DESKEW_MUTANT_KILLED", x["mismatching_ops"])' {RUN}/b_mut_deskew.json; test $rc -eq 0
